translation.cz a b: H b; CX a b; H b
translation.swap a b: CX a b; CX b a; CX a b
translation.Zd a b c (.qc): the ccz list reversed with every gate inverted
translation.cswap a b c: CX c b; ccx a b c; CX c b

feynman.redistribution: allowed; keep the copyright notice and the disclaimer
feynman.about: The Feynman / T-par benchmark suite (Amy, Maslov, Mosca): arithmetic and reversible-logic circuits used across the T-count literature. `benchmarks/qasm/*.qasm`, written with `ccx`.

tzap.redistribution: allowed; keep the licence and state changes
tzap.about: TZAP's benchmark corpora: a pre-decomposed copy of the Feynman suite (used here as a cross-check of the translation), block-encoding circuits from Cobble after Rz synthesis, and large synthesised QFTs.

qasmbench.redistribution: allowed; keep the copyright notice and the disclaimers
qasmbench.about: QASMBench (Li, Stein, Krishnamoorthy, Ang): only the files that are exactly Clifford+T once `ccx`, `cz`, `swap`, `cswap` and gate definitions are expanded and terminal measurements are dropped.

qec.licence: none stated (the repository of this project's author)
qec.redistribution: not vendored here beyond the three files already under benchmarks/
qec.about: Nineteen purely unitary QEC circuits: encoders, cat and GHZ states, transversal gates.

pyzx_repo.redistribution: PyZX's own outputs: allowed. The Nam et al. files come from github.com/njross/optimizer, which has no licence file, and the T-par outputs from a GPL-3.0 tool: fetched, never vendored
pyzx_repo.about: Published optimiser outputs for the Feynman suite, kept in the PyZX repository: Nam–Ross–Su–Childs–Maslov light and heavy, T-par, PyZX.

generated.about: Parametric textbook constructions, generated at any size.
